issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Water Fund 82,038.16 / Sewer Fund 37,481.00
issues.issue: These are utility fund collections, which the user's 2026-10-28 rule puts in Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. Applies to receipts[10] and receipts[11]. The printed label is only 'Other', so this remains an assumption.
This capital outlay line is not relabelled 'Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways' (with printed_label) as the user's capital outlay rule requires.

beginning_cash and ending_cash are the cash-plus-investments subtotals, so beginning_investments (77,918.52) and ending_investments (40,368.21) are already included in them. The notes say the investment fields are informational, but anything that adds cash and investments would count these amounts twice.
